narrative:
## Handover Summary — Commodity Price Scenarios

Price scenarios validated for Brent, OSP differentials, gas, NGLs, product cracks, polymer spreads and carbon.

## Key Decisions
• Plan at USD 72/bbl Brent, budget at USD 75 held as upside
• Polymer spread reset to USD 280/t for H1
• H2 sales gas raised to 10.8 bscfd

signals.title: Brent sensitivity: $2.1B revenue per $1/bbl
signals.source: Meridian Corporate Planning — price deck model
signals.excerpt: Every $1/bbl Brent move changes FY2026 revenue by about $2.1B and net income by about $0.9B after the price-linked royalty tier and 46% effective tax.
